_comment: The cross-book used-names registry. Book N+1 checks against this so it cannot reuse a name
book N deliberately renamed away from — a defect that has already shipped once (R1).
Format: {"Name": ["book", ...]}. Keys are single capitalised tokens; continuity.py matches
them against every Firstname-Surname pair it finds in the manuscript.
IT IS CURRENTLY EMPTY, so `continuity.py --names` reports zero cross-book reuse and that
result means nothing yet. Populate it at Stage 11 harvest from each finished manuscript
before treating the check as a gate.
